scene: You climb high above the gardens to the transit lookout.
picture: Flat side view. Along the wide terrace platform, a turquoise harbour ferry sits moored at a pier on the far left. The player, carrying her red umbrella, stands centre-left facing right. In the centre, an open subway stairwell glows. On the right waits a cheerful yellow street tram with open passenger doors.
shown: A turquoise harbour ferry tied to a pier dock on the far left
A lit subway entrance staircase leading underground in the centre
A bright yellow street tram idling with doors open on the right

variants.scene: Salty harbour air fills the breeze on this bustling sunset transit dock.
You reach the pier station, still searching across the city for {quest}.
Sunset glows behind the skyline as evening commuters gather by the platforms.
